coverage_limits: Executed on October 30, 2026. October 28 and 29 are retrospective date-targeted passes; October 30 ends at 06:40:59 America/Chicago. Original UTC event times are retained.

Three separate bounded browser passes were executed. Related evidence found in another pass is explicitly recorded as a cross-pass supplement, not a new search. Papers with verified October 28 or 29 local dates are assigned to those reports.
Selective arXiv cs.GR, cs.CV and cs.HC listing inspection; other arXiv categories were not separately enumerated. OpenReview and official venues received indexed searches only.
The installed skill prepare/finalize workflow ran with live browser retrieval. This was not a separate API harness benchmark run.
The live taxonomy document revision differs from the pinned October 11 codebook. Classifications retain the pinned codebook; the new document was not reconciled.
Seven-day lookback results are distinguished from same-day submissions. Known IDs are deduplicated against the existing website; title changes do not create a new paper.
Search indexes may lag. This bounded pass does not establish field-wide completeness. Selected-method and abstract-only readings are identified per record.

papers.abstract: Combines image-based mesh generation with agent-guided construction and repair of physical interactions.
papers.screening_reason: The agent uses geometry tools and simulated interaction evidence to revise joints, parts and surface bindings.

papers.contribution: Combines image-based mesh generation with agent-guided construction and repair of physical interactions.
papers.limitations: Single-image physical properties are inferred; selected passages were inspected, without reproducing the experiments.

papers.screening_reason: A critic checks the rendered advertisement and feeds revisions back into prompt generation.

papers.limitations: Evidence covers the main method; supplementary details and experimental results were not independently reproduced.

papers.abstract: Discusses agent harnesses for video production, interactive world models and recursive improvement.
papers.screening_reason: A directly relevant synthesis of graphics-related agent runtimes, rather than a new implemented authoring system.

papers.canonical_title: DIP-CAD: A Design-Intent-Preserving Agent Harness for Parametric CAD Modeling
papers.abstract: Uses explicit geometry references and sketch constraints to preserve parametric CAD design intent.
papers.screening_reason: VLM-guided modeling commands and sketches interact with CAD geometry and solver checks.

screening_evidence.evidence: The VLM predicts commands from tagged model views and geometry tables; sketch primitives are mapped into CAD coordinates and constraints are validated by the solver.

papers.contribution: Uses explicit geometry references and sketch constraints to preserve parametric CAD design intent.
papers.limitations: Already in the library under the earlier title Vision2CAD. This record captures the verified v3 title and timing; version-to-version changes were not audited.
